name: ProofStories

sources.title: Homepage — indie startup directory (est. 2026), weekly launch waves on Wednesdays 09:00 UTC, upvote counts on listings
Plans — Standard Launch Free (queue + homepage for days), Sponsored $9.99/launch (skip queue), Premium $39.99/launch (newsletter + social)
Submit route — JS-rendered, requires 'Login with Google'

requirements: Indie startup / maker product — directory self-describes as 'the indie startup directory' with verified-MRR positioning
Free Standard Launch goes into a queue and ships in a weekly launch wave (next wave Wednesday 09:00 UTC)
Paid options exist purely for speed/placement: Sponsored $9.99 skips queue, Premium $39.99 adds newsletter + social
preparation: Product name, URL, one-line description, and category (listings show category chips like 'AI & Machine Learning', 'Developer Tools')
MRR figure if willing to share — site tracks 'verified MRR' across the directory
workflow: Sign in with Google on proofstories.io
Open /submit and fill the product form
Choose Standard (free, queued) — or Sponsored/Premium if speed matters
Free launches go live in the Wednesday 09:00 UTC wave; top-3 ranked products get a badge
Promote the listing during its homepage days — upvotes (▲) drive ranking
watchFor: Weekly-batch launch model: free submissions wait for the next wave — submit early in the week
Sponsored slots are clearly labelled; paying doesn't fake organic rank
Young directory (est. 2026, ~777 startups claimed) — modest but real launch-wave mechanics
Verified-MRR positioning may mean revenue claims get checked — don't inflate
countsAsLive: A product page resolves at proofstories.io/directory/products/<slug>/ with upvote count, category, and View link
unknowns: How long the free queue actually takes (wave cadence is weekly)
Whether directory outbound links are followed
